headline: Operations Transformation Lead
profile: Operations leader with 15 years' experience restructuring teams and re-engineering processes, most recently as Head of Esports Operations at BLAST. Led a six-person department delivering tournament and player operations, and rebuilt how it worked, with clearer ownership, accountability and documentation. Designed and built a suite of tools to replace the department's spreadsheets, covering tournament operations, freelancer staffing, travel and scheduling, tested with freelancers and staff before rollout. Separately scoped and prototyped an AI system to automate attendance tracking at a major tournament, documenting detection methods, privacy safeguards and rollout risk for stakeholder sign-off. Managed budgets, prize money and vendor accounts with strong governance and competitive-integrity controls, and wrote business cases for senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Head of Esports Operations

Scoped and built an early prototype of an AI system to automate attendance tracking at a 100-player tournament, documenting detection methods, privacy safeguards, rollout plan and risk
